title: Exposure Integrity Engine
boundary: The Hit List is an investigative-priority and navigation surface, not a threat list, guilt ranking or call for harassment. Inclusion means the entity has documented power relevance, an evidence-backed accountability record, a significant unresolved evidence gap or a clearly labelled public claim requiring investigation.
improvements: 172 graph edges remain in the provenance-restoration queue and cannot be used as facts or timer triggers.
3 generic Dark Files lane(s) were kept as analytical inference until case-specific sources are attached.
1 duplicate cross-registry evidence record(s) were merged while preserving all source routes and registry origins.
